test_report: HEART Component 3 Backend Reliability & Robustness Audit

reliability_invariants_tested.invariant: Rejection of unmapped defect classes beyond supported single primary scope.
Strict physical coordinate validation [x1, y1, x2, y2] preventing inverted or negative bounding boxes.
Partial or corrupt screen analysis evaluates strictly to inconclusive (has_gui_defect=None), never to false negative clean.
Malformed HTTP payload or corrupt image bytes produces HTTP 400 Bad Request with descriptive diagnostic envelope.
Non-blocking C2 crawler trigger queue acknowledges capture in <150ms and prevents crawler stalls.
Queue saturation beyond capacity 20 returns explicit HTTP 503 Service Unavailable backpressure rather than dropping jobs silently.
CUDA OOM in individual SAHI slices clears torch cache, marks metadata, and returns graceful verdict without crashing process.
C4 handover contract maps nullable defect states and physical pixel coordinates cleanly across version 1.0.0 and 2.0.0 consumers.
